content: निवहः .²1 A multitude, collection, quantity, heap; भुजगनिवहो भूषणनिधिः <ls>Ā. L. 16</ls>; राजपुत्रनिवहः <ls>Bh. 3. 37</ls>; so घन˚, दैत्य˚, कपोत˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the seven winds. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the seven tongues of fire. .²4 Killing, slaughter. --{%a.%} Bringing, causing; कर्माणि पुण्यनिवहानि सुमङ्गलानि <ls>Bhāg. 11. 1. 11</ls>.
